university.name: University of Bedfordshire
university.summary: The University of Bedfordshire offers undergraduate, taught postgraduate and foundation year courses to international students. Its international foundation year page states that it has delivered international foundation courses since 1980, and its fee schedule publishes international fees for 2027/28.

courses.title: Computer Science (Masters)
courses.duration_text: Not stated on the course page; the fee schedule prices taught Masters of up to 15 months at the same fee
courses.overview: A taught master's in computer science delivered in blocks, with units on distributed and parallel computing, intelligent systems and data mining, and network systems, finishing with an MSc project. The page states BCS accreditation.
courses.academic_requirements: 2.2 Honours degree or equivalent in a related area. Pakistan page: 4 years Bachelor's at 55% minimum, or 2 years Bachelor's and 2 years Master's both at 55% minimum.
courses.english_requirements: UKVI Academic IELTS overall 6.0 with minimum 5.5 in each element (general Master's requirement; the page says some courses may require higher levels). PTE Academic Listening 59, Reading 59, Speaking 59, Writing 59 (online test not accepted). TOEFL iBT Listening 17, Reading 18, Speaking 20, Writing 17 (Home Edition not accepted). Duolingo 110 overall with no sub score below 100 for courses requiring IELTS 6.0, for tests after 1 July 2024.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page: 4 years Bachelor's (55% minimum), or 2 years Bachelor's and 2 years Master's degree (both at 55% minimum). The page does not mention CGPA.
courses.career_notes: The page lists roles such as systems or data analyst, programmer, IT project manager and database architect, and states progression to MSc by Research, MPhil or PhD.
courses.notes: Fee GBP 18,250 is the 2027/28 full-time standard fee for a taught Master's stated on the course page and the fee schedule. Intake months are not stated on the page (the apply links carry numeric intake codes only), so intake_labels is empty. The page does not say which units are core or optional, and mentions further units under View More Units. PTE and TOEFL overall scores are not stated, only section scores.

courses.title: International Business (Masters)
courses.duration_text: Not stated on the course page; the fee schedule prices taught Masters of up to 15 months at the same fee
courses.overview: A taught master's delivered in six-week blocks, covering international trade and monetary policy, strategy, intercultural business practice and international business design, and ending in an independent research project.
courses.academic_requirements: 2.2 Honours degree or equivalent in a related area. Pakistan page: 4 years Bachelor's at 55% minimum, or 2 years Bachelor's and 2 years Master's both at 55% minimum.
courses.english_requirements: UKVI Academic IELTS overall 6.0 with minimum 5.5 in each element (general Master's requirement; the page says some courses may require higher levels). PTE Academic Listening 59, Reading 59, Speaking 59, Writing 59 (online test not accepted). TOEFL iBT Listening 17, Reading 18, Speaking 20, Writing 17 (Home Edition not accepted). Duolingo 110 overall with no sub score below 100 for courses requiring IELTS 6.0, for tests after 1 July 2024.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page: 4 years Bachelor's (55% minimum), or 2 years Bachelor's and 2 years Master's degree (both at 55% minimum). The page does not mention CGPA.
courses.career_notes: The page lists trading executive, product manager, business development manager and buyer roles, and a foundation for MPhil or PhD study.
courses.notes: Fee GBP 18,250 is the 2027/28 full-time standard fee for a taught Master's stated on the course page and the fee schedule. Intake months and duration are not stated on the page. The page does not say which modules are core or optional.

courses.title: Business Management with International Business
courses.duration_text: Modules are listed for Years 1 to 3; a four-year integrated Foundation Year route is also offered
courses.overview: A business degree combining management with international business, with Year 1 modules on numeracy and management practice, Year 2 on cross-cultural management and international new ventures, and Year 3 on international economics and a business project.
courses.academic_requirements: The page lists 96 UCAS tariff points, including 80 from at least 3 A-levels or equivalent, and also 48 UCAS tariff points, including 32 from at least 1 A-level or equivalent, without saying which route applies to which entry. Pakistan page: Year 12 at 60% minimum, or 2 year Bachelor degree at 55% minimum, or 2 A level passes (C and D minimum), or International Baccalaureate 24 points minimum, or a recognised Foundation year.
courses.english_requirements: UKVI Academic IELTS overall 6.0 with minimum 5.5 in each element (general Bachelor's requirement; the page says some courses may require higher levels). PTE Academic Listening 59, Reading 59, Speaking 59, Writing 59 (online test not accepted). TOEFL iBT Listening 17, Reading 18, Speaking 20, Writing 17 (Home Edition not accepted). Duolingo 110 overall with no sub score below 100 for courses requiring IELTS 6.0, for tests after 1 July 2024.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page: Year 12 (60% minimum); 2 year Bachelor degree (55% minimum); 2 A level passes (C and D minimum); International Baccalaureate (24 points minimum); or a recognised Foundation year. The page does not mention CGPA.
courses.career_notes: The page lists general business, operations and project management roles, and progression to taught Master's courses such as the MBA.
courses.notes: Fee GBP 18,150 per year is the 2027/28 international fee on the course page and the fee schedule. Intake months and standard duration are not stated. The page does not say which modules are core or optional. The optional placement year is stated as only available to UK/EU students.

courses.title: Bedfordshire International Foundation Year (Engineering)
courses.duration_text: One year, delivered over two semesters
courses.overview: A one-year international foundation course that combines English language, academic skills and an engineering fundamentals unit, with progression routes to listed engineering, construction management and software engineering degrees.
courses.academic_requirements: The page lists no academic qualifications, only English language requirements. Progression routes: Automotive Engineering BEng (Hons), Construction Management BSc (Hons), Electronic Engineering BEng (Hons), Mechanical Engineering BEng (Hons), Software Engineering BSc (Hons).
courses.english_requirements: IELTS at a minimum 4.5 in all skills, evidenced by a UKVI-approved Secure English Language Test (SELT) such as IELTS. The page states the course aims to take students to IELTS 6.0 overall.
courses.notes: The page describes GBP 18,150 as the full-time standard undergraduate tuition fee for 2027/28 and gives no separate foundation year fee; the fee schedule lists both foundation year options at GBP 18,150 for 2027/28 and says the lower fee option reverts to the undergraduate fee after the foundation year. Mode is not stated directly (fee wording refers to full-time). Intake months not stated. The page does not mark modules core or optional. The Pakistan page names only 'a recognised Foundation year' and gives no foundation entry grades.

scholarships.name: High Achievers Undergraduate Scholarship for Pakistan
scholarships.value_text: GBP 3,000 off international tuition per year
scholarships.summary: A tuition reduction for international fee-paying undergraduates entering Level 4 with high Pakistani Year 12 results. It does not apply to the International Foundation Year and cannot be held alongside other scholarships.
scholarships.criteria_text: International fee payer entering Level 4 (first year) with 75% or more in the Pakistani Year 12 exams (fees page). The Pakistan page states 900/1100 or more. Cannot hold other scholarships but remains eligible for prompt payment discounts.
scholarships.deadline_note: No deadline or application route stated.
scholarships.notes: Sources conflict on the threshold (75% on the fees page, 900/1100 on the Pakistan page). Terms are stated for 2026/27 entry; 2027/28 terms not seen.

scholarships.name: International Undergraduate Subject-specific Scholarship
scholarships.summary: A tuition reduction for international fee payers holding an offer for the first year of an eligible undergraduate course. An online interview may be required.
scholarships.criteria_text: International fee payer with an offer for Level 4 on an eligible course; may require an online interview.
scholarships.deadline_note: No deadline or application route stated.
scholarships.notes: The list of eligible courses was not opened, so eligibility of the courses in this file is unconfirmed. Terms are stated for 2026/27 entry.

scholarships.name: A level and IB Scholarship
scholarships.summary: A tuition reduction for international undergraduates entering Level 4 with an IB Diploma of 33 points or more, or A levels of ABB or higher from the listed boards.
scholarships.criteria_text: IB Diploma 33+ points or A levels ABB+ from eligible boards (CIE, Oxford AQA, Edexcel, LRN, Singapore-Cambridge; all UK A levels), entering Level 4.
scholarships.deadline_note: No deadline or application route stated.

scholarships.name: International Foundation Year Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 5,000 for the first year only
scholarships.summary: A tuition reduction for international students starting a level 3 foundation year in 2026/27, applied to the first year only.
scholarships.deadline_note: No deadline or application route stated.
scholarships.notes: Stated for 2026/27 starts only; 2027/28 terms not seen.

scholarships.name: Postgraduate Global Merit Scholarship
scholarships.summary: A fee reduction for international postgraduate applicants with a 75% GPA or equivalent in a bachelor's degree. University of Bedfordshire undergraduate progressers are also eligible.
scholarships.criteria_text: International fee payer with 75% GPA or equivalent in a bachelor's degree, applying for a postgraduate course.
scholarships.deadline_note: No deadline or application route stated on the fees page.
scholarships.notes: The Pakistan page describes this award as open for applications made between September 2024 and July 2025, while the fees page lists it for 2026/27; sources conflict on whether it is current.

scholarships.name: Postgraduate Global Subject-Specific Merit Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: Up to GBP 4,000 off course fees
scholarships.summary: A fee reduction of up to a stated amount for international applicants with a 75% GPA or equivalent in a bachelor's degree who hold an offer on an eligible level 7 course.
scholarships.criteria_text: 75% GPA or equivalent in a bachelor's degree and an offer on an eligible level 7 course.
scholarships.deadline_note: No deadline or application route stated.
scholarships.notes: The eligible course list was not opened, so eligibility of the courses in this file is unconfirmed. Terms are stated for 2026/27 entry.

scholarships.name: Vice Chancellor's Scholarship for Undergraduate Students
scholarships.value_text: GBP 1,000 off the first year's fees
scholarships.summary: A first-year fee reduction on bachelor's courses, applying only when no other scholarship is received. International Foundation Year progressers are also covered.
scholarships.criteria_text: Bachelor's courses; applies only if no other scholarship is received; also for International Foundation Year progressers.
scholarships.deadline_note: No deadline or application route stated.

scholarships.name: Vice Chancellor's Scholarship for Postgraduate Students
scholarships.value_text: GBP 1,000 off the first year's fees
scholarships.summary: A first-year fee reduction on Master's courses including the MBA. It is not available to University of Bedfordshire undergraduate progressers.
scholarships.criteria_text: Master's courses, including MBA; not for University of Bedfordshire undergraduate progressers.
scholarships.deadline_note: No deadline or application route stated.

scholarships.name: Prompt Payment Discount
scholarships.summary: A discount for paying each year's fees in full before or at registration. It can be held alongside other scholarships, which are applied to the remaining balance after 65% pre-payment.
scholarships.criteria_text: Full payment of each year's fees before or at registration; undergraduate, postgraduate and research. Pre-payment of 65% of the full published tuition fees is required, with scholarships applied to the balance.
scholarships.deadline_note: Payment before or at registration each year.
scholarships.notes: The fees page refers to the Tuition Fees Policy for terms; that policy page was not opened.

scholarships.name: Alumni Scholarship
scholarships.summary: A 20% reduction in first-year fees for graduates of the University of Bedfordshire, including overseas partners, DMU's Bedford campus or the University of Luton, entering full-time on-campus postgraduate courses.
scholarships.criteria_text: Honours degree from the University of Bedfordshire (including overseas partners), DMU's Bedford campus or the University of Luton; full-time, on-campus postgraduate courses.
scholarships.deadline_note: No deadline or application route stated.
scholarships.notes: The terms page for this award was not opened. Terms are stated for 2026/27 entry.
